quests.dispatcherQuestion: A worker's sleeve has caught in a printer's moving parts. Input safety code!
quests.hint: Stop the equipment before anything else.
quests.explanation: Cutting power to the machine immediately stops it from causing further injury while help arrives.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A boy fell from the top of a slide and is holding his arm. Input medical code!
quests.hint: Say who needs to reach the patient quickly.
quests.explanation: A fall from height can cause a fracture, so paramedics should check him before he is moved.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A large dog has bitten a delivery driver on the leg. Input medical code!
quests.hint: Ask for the vehicle that can treat him on the way to hospital.
quests.explanation: Dog bites can cause deep wounds and infection risk, so paramedics should clean and treat it properly.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Two cars have gently collided at a junction and both drivers seem shaken. Input police code!
quests.hint: Ask for a police vehicle already on the road.
quests.explanation: A patrol officer can check both drivers are unhurt and record what happened for the report.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A strong smell of gas is spreading through an apartment corridor. Input safety code!
quests.hint: Let the gas escape before doing anything else.
quests.explanation: Opening windows lets the gas disperse safely while everyone moves clear of the building.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A woman has slipped on a wet supermarket floor and can't stand. Input medical code!
quests.hint: Stress both the team needed and the urgency.
quests.explanation: A hard fall on a hard floor can injure a hip or wrist, so trained help should check her.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A shopper reports a man following her closely through the parking lot. Input police code!
quests.hint: Let the police know what you're seeing.
quests.explanation: A dispatched unit can reach her quickly and make sure she gets to her car safely.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A pot left on the stove has caught fire and is spreading to the curtains. Input fire code!
quests.hint: Name the vehicle firefighters arrive in.
quests.explanation: A fire that has already spread to fabric needs a full crew, not just a single unit.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A boy has swallowed a small coin and is coughing but breathing. Input medical code!
quests.hint: Name the vehicle that carries paramedics.
quests.explanation: A swallowed coin may still block the airway later, so paramedics should assess him right away.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A group of children is trapped in a stuck elevator at the mall. Input rescue code!
quests.hint: Ask for the team trained in this kind of rescue.
quests.explanation: A trained rescue team can open the doors safely without the elevator suddenly moving.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A man has cut his finger badly while chopping vegetables. Input medical code!
quests.hint: Say what should be done to slow the bleeding.
quests.explanation: Firm pressure on the cut slows the bleeding until help arrives or he reaches a clinic.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A car alarm is going off and a man is seen prying open the door. Input police code!
quests.hint: Send the service that handles this kind of incident.
quests.explanation: A car alarm plus someone forcing the door is a clear sign of an attempted theft.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Heavy rain has flooded the entrance of an underground parking garage. Input safety code!
quests.hint: Stop more water and cars getting in.
quests.explanation: Closing the entrance keeps cars from driving into rising water and getting stuck or swept along.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A restaurant customer's throat is closing up after eating peanuts. Input medical code!
quests.hint: Ask for help urgently, using the word 'now'.
quests.explanation: A closing throat is a severe allergic reaction, and paramedics carry medicine that can reverse it quickly.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A man is seen trying door handles along a row of parked delivery vans. Input police code!
quests.hint: Send an official police vehicle to the scene.
quests.explanation: A patrol car nearby can respond fast enough to catch someone checking for unlocked vehicles.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A worker has splashed cleaning bleach into his eyes at a hotel. Input medical code!
quests.hint: Say what should be done before anything else.
quests.explanation: Rinsing with clean water immediately limits the damage bleach can do to the eyes.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Smoke detectors are sounding on every floor of an office building. Input fire code!
quests.hint: Get everyone out before checking anything else.
quests.explanation: Getting everyone out first is always the priority when smoke alarms sound throughout a building.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A cyclist swerved and was struck by a delivery van at low speed. Input medical code!
quests.hint: Ask plainly for someone trained to treat them.
quests.explanation: Even a low-speed impact can cause hidden injuries, so paramedics should assess him before he moves.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A man reports his motorbike was stolen from outside his flat overnight. Input police code!
quests.hint: Say what the officer should do first.
quests.explanation: A written report starts the search and is needed for any insurance claim he makes.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A candle left burning has set a bedroom curtain on fire. Input fire code!
quests.hint: Ask for the team that puts out fires.
quests.explanation: A curtain fire can spread through a room in under a minute, so help should be called immediately.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: An elderly woman has a deep gash on her leg from a fall. Input medical code!
quests.hint: Say what needs to happen before anything else.
quests.explanation: Controlling the bleeding first is the priority for a deep cut, even before help arrives.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A toddler has climbed onto a balcony railing three floors up. Input safety code!
quests.hint: Say the most urgent action needed right now.
quests.explanation: Getting the child to safety is the only priority until he is off the railing.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A fight has broken out between two customers at a bar. Input police code!
quests.hint: Ask for the police, and stress the urgency.
quests.explanation: A patrol car can separate the two men quickly before anyone is seriously hurt.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A woman has burned her hand badly on a hot oven tray. Input medical code!
quests.hint: Say the first treatment step for a burn.
quests.explanation: Cool running water on a burn straight away reduces the damage to the skin.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A gas cooker has been left on unlit in a student flat. Input safety code!
quests.hint: Say the first thing that must be shut off.
quests.explanation: Shutting off the gas supply removes the risk of it building up and igniting.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A man is seen filming inside a stranger's window with his phone. Input police code!
quests.hint: Ask for police, and stress the urgency.
quests.explanation: This kind of behavior can be a crime, so police should be told while the man is still nearby.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A teenager is having a severe asthma attack and has no inhaler nearby. Input medical code!
quests.hint: Ask for the medical team by name.
quests.explanation: Without an inhaler, a severe asthma attack needs paramedics who carry the right medication and oxygen.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A tree has fallen across a road after strong winds, blocking traffic. Input safety code!
quests.hint: Say what should be done to protect drivers.
quests.explanation: Closing the road stops other cars from hitting the tree or driving under a weakened branch.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A man collapsed at a bus stop and bystanders can't wake him. Input medical code!
quests.hint: Ask for the medical team, and add urgency.
quests.explanation: Someone who won't wake up needs urgent medical attention, so an ambulance must be sent immediately.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A group of youths is spray-painting a school wall late at night. Input police code!
quests.hint: Say who's needed, and where.
quests.explanation: A patrol car can respond quickly while the group is still at the scene.
